component.name: Mini Tokyo 3D
component.summary: See Tokyo’s trains, buses and flights move in real time

description.p: Mini Tokyo 3D is a real-time 3D digital map of Tokyo’s public transport system. Every train runs along the railway network by its timetable and live delays, together with buses and the flights at Haneda and Narita airports.
This GNOME app runs the same Mini Tokyo 3D as minitokyo3d.com, with all of its features:

ul.li: Trains, buses and flights in 3D, sized and scaled with the zoom as on the website
Live cameras, precipitation, fireworks, PLATEAU 3D city and GTFS bus plugins
Train information, station details, route search and playback of any time
Follows the system’s light or dark style, with keyboard shortcuts and fullscreen

description.p: The map needs a free Mapbox access token, which the app asks for on first launch and keeps in GNOME Keyring.
First release of the GNOME app.
